resources.string: The joystick is running. Changes apply the next time the joystick starts.
Looks up the altitude online (Open-Meteo) when it is unknown. Uses data.
Unfortunately, it seems like we can\'t open Developer Options for you…
Always ignores the mock location check before starting the joystick.
Prevents any app from taking screenshots when the joystick is visible.
Displays the distance and time from the last mocked location to a new selected location. (Green = Generally OK, Red = Too Far Too Soon)

*Requires Android version Marshmallow or higher on an older version of Google Play Services.* This feature broadcasts a mock location for a short period and then suspends broadcasting to let apps pick up the last known location.
Repeats the last suspended location after the specified interval.
The interval used to broadcast the last suspended location.
*Requires Android version Marshmallow or higher on an older version of the security patch.* This feature prevents apps from detecting mock location being enabled in developer options.
Uses hidden ILocationManager API (system app required). Only works on Android < 10. Bypasses mock detection.
This helps prevent jumping to real location by forcing the GPS to reset. **Uses data**
Helpful for users experiencing issues with the joystick disappearing. Saves the location while moving so it can be restored. *Not recommended, may degrade performance.
Automatically close this app after the joystick control is started.
Automatically start the joystick control when you select a favorite or route.
Sorry there was an issue retrieving the list of apps installed on your device.
Generate a cloned APK with randomized package name to avoid detection
Clone generation started. The app will install the new APK automatically.
Failed to generate clone app. Check logs for details.

This will generate a cloned APK with a randomized package name to avoid detection by anti-fraud apps. The cloned app will be signed with the debug keystore. This increases APK size significantly. Uninstall any previous clones before generating a new one. The A-GPS reset will only auto-run when the cloned app is detected. Continue?
Save your favorites, routes and markers to a file.
Replace all data with a saved file. The app will restart.

Please restart the app for changes to take effect.

The settings below are used to emulate realistic GPS values by creating random errors for mocked values. Only change these settings if you know what you are doing. Erratic behavior may occur if set incorrectly!
The interval used to broadcast all mocked values. This value should always be lesser than all intervals below to prevent skipped updates.
The interval used to update the change in location when moving.
The interval used to update the change in location when idle.
The +/- offset used in the calculation to determine a random location when idle.
The +/- offset used in the calculation to determine the heading angle when moving.
The +/- offset used in the calculation to determine the speed when moving.
The +/- offset used in the calculation to determine a random altitude when moving.
The minimum location accuracy used when idle.
The maximum location accuracy used when idle.
The minimum location accuracy used when moving.
The maximum location accuracy used when moving.
